description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rilawala, Homagama  D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520024
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, encumbrances, and other property-related particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
